integrity: The theorem relies on a direct phase proof of the interlacing of even and odd generating polynomials, positive-residue coefficient-ratio inequalities, a boundary limiting argument, and an explicit sharpness witness. Finite tests are supplementary; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Both integer and half-integer parity classes must have positive mass. The exact half-unit adjacency statement requires all three probabilities positive for every summand. The result does not settle unconditional modes, mode-to-mean proximity, or ranking/assignment optimization.
title: Sharp adjacent parity modes for Poisson trinomial sums
